notes:
Summary: Ironhaven is a mid-to-large support SaaS (ticketing + automation) looking to replace their ES/BM25 retrieval stack with an embeddings + learned reranker pipeline to increase top-5 answer quality and deflect tickets. Primary metrics: improve deflection rate from 18% -> 32% for first-contact answers; ensure top-5 rerank quality (precision@5) >= 0.9 on sampled queries; maintain strict latency SLOs (target end-to-end p95 <= 250ms for retrieval + rerank in production).

Scale & current state:
- They hold ~15M historical tickets and attached KB articles; expect growth to 40M docs in 12 months.
- Current throughput: ~120 qps peak, bursty around support spikes. Forecast growth: 300 qps within 9 months.
- Current cost target: <$0.005 per query (all-in) for retrieval+rerank; procurement sensitive to per-query unit economics.

Technical requirements and preferences:
- Retrieval: want dense embeddings for recall; evaluating single-vector vs multi-vector for long-form tickets.
- Indexing: need line-rate reindexing and incremental updates for agent notes (low-latency staleness < 2 minutes for critical flows).
- Reranking: prefer a learned cross-encoder reranker that re-scores top-100 candidates to deliver a high-quality top-5. They require model explainability hooks for production debugging.
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for retrieval+rerank on their Dedicated nodes in NA; p50 target < 80ms.
- Fallbacks: graceful fallback to BM25 if vector DB region unavailable; automated routing to lower-cost model for non-critical queries.

Security & compliance: SOC2 required; customer needs SSO/SAML and centralized audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Data residency: primary EU customers require EU-hosted indexes. KMS integration mandatory for Private/Dedicated.

POC plan proposed by Redwood: 6-week pilot using Dedicated pool (2 GPU workers) + Optimize runbook:
- Week 0: finalize infra (VPC peering), legal NDA & residency clause; SSO test account creation.
- Week 1: ingest 15M-ticket sample (subset) into vector index; baseline BM25 metrics captured.
- Week 2-3: iterate embedding model selection and quantization profile; run offline rerank evals for precision@5 and latency tradeoffs.
- Week 4-5: end-to-end integration with agent UI, production-like load test (200-300 qps), p95 latency profiling and tuning (batching/caching).
- Week 6: handoff, evaluation report, ROI model with cost-per-query estimates and recommended Dedicated sizing or Private deployment.

POC acceptance criteria:
- Precision@5 >= 0.90 on validation set,
- End-to-end p95 retrieval+rerank <= 250ms under 200 qps synthetic load,
- All security controls verified (SSO, audit logs, KMS),
- Cost model showing expected per-query <= $0.005 at target scale.

Quotes & callouts:
- "We need answers that our support agents can trust — top-5 must be good enough to surface without manual triage." — Head of Support (on 2026-02-22 call).
- Client is open to Dedicated or Private if unit economics and latency meet SLOs; prefers Dedicated first for speed of onboarding.

Next steps (short):
- Maya to schedule POC kickoff w/ infra and legal (target week of 2026-03-15).
- SE to provide sizing and rough cost model for dedicated nodes by 2026-03-12.
- Legal to review and circulate data residency clause; blocker until signed.
